wholePhysicalScope: Fitted historic frontage and projecting porch from the named native outline. The National Heritage Board documents the original 27 metre dome height and classical orders.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the zinc rotunda dome, three-arched porch and symmetrical wings.
limitations: The model covers the original Monument Building frontage and rotunda. Later rear gallery wings and the independent modern glass rotunda are outside this exterior scope.
The archive confirms the original composition. Exact rear openings, roof slopes and small heraldic and floral ornament are representative.
